content: प्रकीर्ण {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Scattered about, scattered forth, thrown about, dispersed; प्रकीर्णमूर्धजा राजन् यक्षाधिपतिमब्रुवन् <ls>Mb. 3. 161. 17</ls>. .²2 Spread, published, promulgated. .²3 Waved, waving; जवात् प्रकीर्णैरभितः प्रकीर्णकैः <ls>Śi. 12. 17</ls>. .²4 Disordered, loose, dishevelled. .²5 Confused, incoherent; बह्वपि स्वेच्छया कामं प्रकीर्णमभिधीयते <ls>Śi. 2. 63</ls>. .²6 Agitated, excited. .²7 Miscellaneous, mixed; as the प्रकीर्णकाण्ड of Bhaṭṭikāvya. .²8 Expanded, opened. .²9 Standing alone. .²10 Destroyed, killed; प्रकीर्णमेष भारं हि यद्वद्धार्येत दस्युभिः <ls>Mb. 12. 215. 14</ls>. .²11 Thickly covered; प्रकीर्णमलपङ्कः <ls>Dk. 2. 2</ls>. .{@-र्णम्@} .²1 A miscellany, any miscellaneous collection. .²2 A chapter containing miscellaneous rules. .²3 A chapter or section of a book. .²4 Scattering or throwing about. .²5 Extent.
